prospero_win.status: development-source; release kit and native acceptance pending
prospero_win.note: Up to fe8db51 (Wine 0966, 0967 and 0990-0992, [input] mode = playstation, the rumble tuned by feel): see this file's git history. bbf712b follows a virtual link when a path ends in a slash, so a drive root reaches Wine (ntdll.prx and wineserver.prx), 3f00982 adds Wine patch 0977 (GetLogicalDrives opens each letter's root when nothing is published; kernelbase.dll) and 37576d0 Wine patch 0979 (a title's root directory reports /data's free space; ntdll). They take effect from the next kit. 3b87bca adds Wine patch 0968 (the pointer stays on the image under a display mode; win32u.prx), from the next kit too. 53c454f and 7537eb0 add the USB drive search and its wait screen to the title shell (capability game-root-usb-search), from the next kit too. fc7f6ba adds Wine patch 0969 (msvcp80 and msvcp90 export ctype<char>::narrow as native's jump through the vtable, so Spider-Man: Web of Shadows no longer crashes after Press Start; msvcp80.dll and msvcp90.dll, now built with the kit), and 86d1917 adds Wine patch 0978 and changes 0995 (a display mode smaller than the desktop is shown and pointed at where win32u puts it, so an 800x600 DirectDraw game's pointer reaches the right edge; win32u.prx). Kit 0.20 carries both. 88caebe adds Wine patches 1000-1002 (WINE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE gives a 32-bit program 4 GB, ntdll.prx; ID3DXEffectCompiler::CompileShader, every d3dx9_NN.dll; an EMFILE log by class, wineserver.prx) and takes patch numbers up to 1999; e91bf0b takes 4096 bytes of launch arguments and 16384-byte profiles, and 180f03d WINE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE and the open-file budgets in [environment]. 84785c8 adds Wine patches 1003-1005 (nsiproxy hosted in a 64-bit game, dnsapi fails instead of faulting, a 32-bit address space log), b0656ab patch 1006 (a mouse and a keyboard in the raw input device list), ab6fc6e the translator's decimal-adjust instructions, and 5bd69cc patch 1007 (VirtualQuery reports only reserved space as free to a 32-bit program). 74fa4b0 has the translator start over when one PC piles up retired blocks (wowprospero.prx), and bb7d152 adds [environment] PW_NSIPROXY_DISABLE (kit capability nsiproxy-switch) with Wine patch 1008 (the controller's HID drivers without nsiproxy, ntdll.dll), 7ae9bdb patch 1009 (files on a completion port park too, wineserver.prx). They take effect from the next kit, with a new shell. 3f07187 adds Wine 1010 (notifications and the invite question from code in the game) and 3c436a8 the Steam host's second process (Wine 1011-1015, the profile's [helper] section, kit capability helper-process, the helper bdj.elf), with a notification when the helper didn't start and its start's steps when a .notify file is beside the ready file, from the next kit too. 99a20ad lets the helper show messages and ask with L3+R3 while the game runs, and 244a115 adds Wine 1016-1018 (a received TOS and TTL on BSD, a send buffer of 0, the network adapters without a DNS configuration; iphlpapi.dll is now built), from the next kit too. 52b93d0 adds [launcher] chain = off (kit capability touchpad-switch): the touchpad swaps to a second preset without a launcher, from the next kit too. b962993 adds the title's [steam] install_dir (kit capability steam-library-path): a Steam game is shown in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common through a virtual link; 2ddfbbf keeps its working directory there and df71ecc finds a virtual link in any letter case (ntdll.prx, wineserver.prx), from the next kit too. 993297a has the translator push and pop a word from memory, as Need for Speed III's Watcom code does (wowprospero.prx), from the next kit too.
